tertiary.usage: Every gold that has words in it on a light ground. 5.89:1 on marble, 5.08:1 on creme.

gold.usage: Ornament and headings on Lacquer Ink only. 2.15:1 on marble: never text, never a meaningful icon, on light grounds.

moss.usage: Labels and small marks on foliage content only (farm, trail, garden). Never a fill larger than a tag.

display-xl.purpose: Names on the home hero only. Capitals, tracked 0.04em, on the axis.

display-lg.purpose: Page titles and inverse-section headings (Gold Leaf on ink).

h1.purpose: Section headings; always paired with an eyebrow and a chevron divider.

h2.purpose: Sub-sections and card titles on featured cards.

h3.purpose: Josefin uppercase; list and form group headings.

body-lg.purpose: Lead paragraphs (Our Story opening, hero sub-line).

body-md.purpose: Default running text. 18px because Josefin has a small x-height; 17px is the floor.

body-sm.purpose: Captions, helper text, muted card text. Never below 17px.

label-caps.purpose: Structural labels only: nav, eyebrows, form labels, section numbers. Not decoration above every heading.

label-sm.purpose: Elevator-panel cell labels: 13px under line icons, 0.04em tracking, one line only.

numeral.purpose: Dates (07 · 17 · 27), section numerals, table numbers. Tabular lining figures.

numeral-xl.purpose: Countdown digits. Crossfade on change; never flip or bounce.

fonts.verified: 2026-09-05 (v24 still served); the current catalog lists the merged variable family "Big Shoulders" with opsz 10..72; when self-hosting, either is acceptable, set opsz=72 on the merged family

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: The fixed mobile elevator panel only. The single shadow in the system.

shadows.name: engraved-inset
shadows.purpose: Inner hairline on primary and accent buttons; reads as an engraved edge, not elevation.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Countdown digit crossfade, panel open/close, input focus tint.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Engraved reveal: a gold hairline draws itself in when a section enters (once).

motion.name: duration-curtain
motion.purpose: Curtain rise on the home hero, once per session.

motion.name: ease-engrave
motion.purpose: Default easing: decisive start, settled end. No overshoot ever.

motion.name: ease-doors
motion.purpose: Symmetric ease for the elevator-doors route transition (two panels part from the axis).

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Digit crossfade and small state changes.

motion.name: choreography.curtain-rise
motion.value: hero: marble panel translates up 100% over duration-curtain with ease-engrave; sunburst opacity 0→0.9 over the last 40%; names fade in 120ms after the panel clears
motion.purpose: One orchestrated moment per page. Home only, first visit per session.

motion.name: choreography.elevator-doors
motion.value: route change: two ink panels close from the left and right edges to the axis (ease-doors, 420ms), then part again over the new page (ease-doors, 480ms); a gold hairline marks the seam
motion.purpose: Route transitions (View Transitions API). Moving through a building, not a tech product.

motion.name: choreography.engraved-reveal
motion.value: section enter: chevron divider stroke-dashoffset 1→0 over duration-reveal; heading opacity 0→1 over 240ms starting at 60%
motion.purpose: Section entrances. Each fires once; no re-trigger on scroll-up.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all choreography replaced by a 120ms opacity fade; countdown digits swap without transition; elevator doors become a crossfade

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Design canvas (iPhone-class). Single column, elevator panel nav.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Two mirrored columns allowed for schedule and adventure grids.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Max content width; frieze nav with monogram centered.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Showcase width; margins grow, content does not.

ornaments.name: sunburst
ornaments.use: Home hero background behind the names, opacity 0.35–0.9. One per site; never repeated on inner pages.

ornaments.name: chevron-rule
ornaments.use: Between major sections, centered on the axis. Draws itself in on first entrance.

ornaments.name: stepped-frame
ornaments.use: Around photographs on the axis (Our Story, Adventures). Never around text.

ornaments.name: corner-bracket
ornaments.use: Four corners (CSS-rotated) of quotes and "Sara remembers / Tyler remembers" panels.

ornaments.name: monogram-plaque
ornaments.use: Nav center, password gate, RSVP confirmation, footer. The date 07 · 17 · 27 is a fact from the brief.

ornaments.name: marble-ground
ornaments.use: Optional page ground at ≤ 6% vein opacity; disabled on print and on data-saver.

ornaments.name: numeral-plaques
ornaments.use: Section numbers for the five acts (Adventure, Place, Memory, Hospitality, Future) and the weekend schedule. Only where content is a sequence.

themeContrast.layoutLogic: Gilded Hour: one centered axis, mirrored margins, monumental plinths. Conservatory: organic asymmetry, offset images, hanging captions.
themeContrast.navPattern: Gilded Hour: a frieze (monogram centered, 3+3 links) on desktop and a fixed bottom elevator panel on mobile. Conservatory: a botanical index / hanging list.
themeContrast.ornament: Gilded Hour: geometric gold (sunburst, chevron, stepped frame, octagon). Conservatory: botanical line-art borders, pressed-flower cards.
themeContrast.rhythm: Gilded Hour: numbered acts, chevron rules, identical section openings. Conservatory: leaves settling, soft parallax, irregular spacing.
themeContrast.type: Gilded Hour: Cinzel / Josefin Sans / Big Shoulders Display. Conservatory: Gloock / Spectral / Cardo italic.
themeContrast.sharedPaletteFamily: white/ivory, gold, light blue, creme/light brown, moss. Gilded Hour leads with marble + gold + lake; Conservatory leads with sky washes over creme + foliage.

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Accent Button (RSVP)

components.description: Marble with a 1px ink border; secondary actions and explicit external handoffs.

narrative.overview: The hour when the late sun comes across Michigan Avenue and turns a marble room gold. An 1893 private club at the height of Chicago's Deco confidence, set for 2027. A plaque, not a poster: engraved, symmetrical, unhurried. Monumentality lives in the frame, never in the effort: big axis, big margins, few things per screen. Ornament reassures; it does not impress.
keyCharacteristics: White marble ground; gold leaf as ornament; bronze as the gold you can read.
One vertical axis on every page; symmetry is the default.
Numbered sections, stepped frames, chevron rules, corner brackets, one sunburst.
Cinzel for words carved in stone, Josefin Sans for words you read, Big Shoulders Display for every number.
Nothing bounces, nothing glows, nothing is rounded past 2px.

rules.name: The Two Golds Rule
rules.body: Gold Leaf decorates; Bronze speaks. Any gold with words in it on a light ground is Bronze. Lines, rays, frames, and headings on ink are Gold Leaf. No third gold.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Lake Blue is a label or a wash, never a button. The only button colors are Lacquer Ink and Bronze.

rules.name: The Axis Rule
rules.body: Everything that matters sits on the page's vertical axis. Body copy is left-aligned inside a centered column; nothing hangs into the gutter.

rules.name: The One Reveal Rule
rules.body: One choreographed moment per page (curtain, elevator doors, or engraved reveal), then stillness. No per-card hover theatre, no scroll-jacking, no parallax.

rules.name: The Real Sequence Rule
rules.body: Section numerals appear only where the content is a sequence: the five acts, the schedule, the story timeline. FAQ and travel are not numbered.

rules.name: The Engraved Rule
rules.body: Depth is a line cut into a surface: hairlines, inset frames, tonal steps. The mobile elevator panel is the only element with a shadow.

dos: Put everything that matters on the axis; let symmetry do the reassuring.
Use Gold Leaf for lines and Bronze for words; check contrast on every pair.
Number only real sequences; open each numbered section the same way.
Keep one choreographed reveal per page and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Use real facts from Sara and Tyler; mark unknowns TODO(Tyler & Sara).
donts: No gold text on marble, no gold buttons, no gold icons that carry meaning.
No pills, no radius above 2px, no shadows on cards, no gradients.
No Inter/Roboto/Arial/Helvetica/Space Grotesk/Fraunces/Playfair/Cormorant; no script faces; no Poiret One.
No purple, no glass, no glow, no bento grid, no hero + three cards.
No bounce or elastic easing; no scroll-jacking; no parallax.
No brochure clone: never the venue's photography, never "timeless elegance".
